_about: Every app event Nova can send. Each event in a line's markers must be listed here. 'does' is what the app should do on screen. tools/build_events.py builds the developers' reference sheet (EVENTS.md) from this list and the lines that use each event. 'cues' lists how a writer may phrase it in a script's [brackets]; the first is the one the preview's Events panel copies. 'scene' groups it in that panel. 'kind' is spotlight or tap (see _rules).

line_end.does: Sent automatically when a line finishes. Use it to move to the next step.

highlight_shops.does: Spotlight the shops on the home map ("See those shops?").

highlight_home.does: Spotlight the home on the map. Tap target: after [Stop highlight] the arrow keeps blinking until the child taps the home.

highlight_sticker_book.does: Spotlight the sticker book in the room.

highlight_closet.does: Spotlight the closet. Tap target: after [Stop highlight] the arrow keeps blinking until the child taps the closet.

highlight_back_arrow.does: Spotlight the back arrow ("Tap the back arrow, and let's go!"). Tap target: after [Stop highlight] the arrow keeps blinking until the child taps it.

highlight_next_world_arrow.does: Spotlight the arrow that rotates to the next world ("Tap the arrow to keep traveling through worlds").

highlight_enter.does: Spotlight the Enter button on the world selection screen.

clear_highlight.does: End the current highlight: the dim fades out. A spotlight's arrow fades with it; a tap target's arrow stays and blinks until the child taps.

nova_exit.does: Nova leaves the screen; the scene stays for the child to explore and choose.

_rules: Every highlight dims the screen with a cut-out around the item, and shows an arrow pointing at it. The dim and the arrow appear together.
A highlight stays until the script says [Stop highlight] (clear_highlight), or until a new highlight replaces it. Finishing the line does not end it.
Spotlight: at [Stop highlight] the dim and the arrow fade out together.
Tap target: at [Stop highlight] the dim fades out, but the arrow stays and blinks until the child taps the item.
